args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and has been failing health checks with an elevated error rate (18%). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Reverted checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out, and the service is now healthy (error rate back to 0.2%).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001): "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — documenting the rollback to v2.3.0 and flagging the v2.3.1 regression for root-cause investigation. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1 again or any other new version, so no change-management approval was needed for this rollback action.
